_comment: Build-in-public projects the content-machine produces + distributes on a cadence. Each project reuses the viral reel formula (data/kb/viral_reel_formula.md), the repurposing agent, the scheduler.py auto-publish daemon (LinkedIn/IG/Threads), and UTM star-attribution.

projects.name: autopilot-jobhunt
projects.pitch: Free AI job agent: scans 130+ careers pages nightly, scores roles vs your resume with an LLM, Telegram-pings top matches, drafts tailored applications.
projects.honesty_guardrail: Scans, scores, notifies, drafts. Does NOT auto-apply. Never say 'auto-applies'.

angle_rotation: new companies added to the scan
a real job a user landed via the shortlist
a live LLM score example (0-100 vs resume)
a new feature shipped (draft, export, MCP)
behind-the-scenes: how the scoring prompt works

channels.instagram: reel + comment->DM (keyword 'jobs') via SuperProfile or CreatorFlow (ManyChat replacements)
channels.youtube_shorts: same cut; repo link line 1 of description + pinned comment
channels.linkedin: active (employer cleared); text post via scheduler.py, repo link in pinned first comment

projects.name: Claude + n8n nightly agent
projects._todo: Set repo_url + dm_link_template to the real public repo once the workflow is pushed.
projects.pitch: Free no-code AI agent: an n8n workflow + Claude prompts that runs a useful job every night (scrape -> summarize -> report) so you wake up to the answer, not the task.
projects.honesty_guardrail: It drafts and summarizes on a schedule — you review the output. It is not autonomous and does not act without you. Never say 'fully automated' or 'runs your life'.
projects.deliverable: n8n workflow JSON (free import) + the Claude prompt pack, in a public repo

projects.name: Claude + Notion: brain-dump -> weekly system
projects._todo: Set dm_link_template to the real public Notion template share URL once duplicated.
projects.pitch: Free Notion template + one Claude prompt that turns a messy brain-dump into a weekly system — your habits, priorities, and reviews, organised in five minutes.
projects.honesty_guardrail: It structures what you give it into a system. It does not build the habit for you or track on its own. Never say it 'fixes your discipline' or 'changes your life'.

projects.name: inbox-to-action
projects.pitch: One command triages your inbox in a single agentic pass: classify, summarize, extract tasks, draft replies. Never sends email (enforced by test). BYOK across 6 LLM providers including fully-local Ollama. pip install inbox-to-action.
projects.honesty_guardrail: Drafts only — it CANNOT send email (no send scope in the codebase, enforced by test). Default provider is cloud (OpenRouter): out of the box, email content goes to a third party; only the ollama/claude providers keep mail local. Not a spam filter, not an email client.

angle_rotation: a real inbox triaged live (unread mail -> tasks + drafts)
a Gmail draft it created, never sent (the safety proof)
a new LLM provider added (BYOK, incl. fully-local Ollama)
a new feature shipped (MCP server, calendar flagging, exports)
behind-the-scenes: how the classification prompt works
